Title: Quadratic roots
Description: Solve $$x^2-5x+6=0$$. What is the larger root?
Explanation: Factoring gives (x-2)(x-3)=0 so x = 2 or x = 3; the larger root is 3.

Title: Pick the even numbers
Description: Which of the following numbers are even?
Explanation: 2 and 8 are even; 3 and 7 are odd. Both correct options must be picked for full marks.

Title: Loop constructs
Description: Which of these are loop constructs in C?
Explanation: for and while repeat a block; if and switch are branches.

Title: Character type
Description: Which C data type stores a single character?
Explanation: The char data type stores exactly one character.
